title: Invalid prints nulled; a series' sign read from its name
problem: sumvolume coded 0 on 21,852 bars (1998-01..2003-06, volume unrecorded); effspread_ew/vw exactly 0 on 43 bars each; spread_vwstock -0.000318 on 2018-11-12 11:00 (its only negative print) switched the whole series to the signed chain from full-sample data
fix: prints breaking their domain -> NaN at load (then the missing-data path); signed/unsigned from the name registry
src_flags: src/data/loading.py:299 NULL_INVALID_PRINTS; src/features/transforms/target.py:170 SIGN_BY_NAME (already in src before this work)
counts: 21,939 prints nulled; 34 of 628 16:00 columns change (adj_spread_vwstock ladders, corr old/new 0.30-0.64)
measured: on top of (b)+(c): f-arm ridge Sharpe -0.007, QLIKE -0.07 %, 7 positions; lasso/enet unchanged (trimmed-target scorer)

title: FOMC 0/1 flags as identity
problem: log(clip(x,1e-12)) mapped 0->-27.63, 1->0; the 1/99 winsoriser then clipped every statement bar of fomc_release back to -27.63 (its 6 ladders constant); fomc_day's ladder was 27.6x its indicator
fix: fomc_release / fomc_day pass through robust_transform unchanged (no log, no winsorising)
counts: 246+3 statement bars; 12 FOMC value columns of the 16:00 design
measured: (b)+(c) together vs the record: QLIKE -0.05..-0.16 %, lasso DM -2.57 (p 0.01), enet Sharpe -0.07 (3 positions), ridge -0.02 (1)

title: Forward-fill limit actually applied
problem: FFILL_LIMIT = 26 (executor.py:75) was never passed (load_and_transform default None; run_executor and run_geometry_local.prepare_full pass nothing); stale values fed every transform statistic and the _active flags
fix: load_and_transform's default ffill_limit='auto' -> FFILL_LIMIT under the flag (covers run_executor and prepare_full)
counts: values carried >26 bars become NaN before the transforms; voldemand ladders move on all test rows (mean |d| 0.15)

title: VIX / VIX3M / VVIX spliced after 2024-02-12
problem: feed ends 2024-02-12: 54 of 866 trade days imputed; the VIX availability ladders sat outside their training range on all 54 (up to -25 IQR) -> linear extrapolation
fix: Yahoo hourly snapshot (data/free_feed/*_1h_yahoo.parquet) after the last print up to 2024-04-30 23:30, at bar ends + 30-minute carry, in the panel's own print slots; only when <data_path>/free_feed exists; never in live (pinned False)
counts: 1,476 VIX, 702 VIX3M, 648 VVIX bars; overlap check: Yahoo == panel print on 96 / 88 / 100 % of 2023-12..2024-02 stamps
measured: with fcal, on top of abcd (trimmed scorer): see linear_scores.csv variant abcd+fcal+vix

title: FOMC calendar completed
problem: data/releases.parquet is a stale pull (every release calendar stops 2023-10..2024-01); 3 scheduled statements missing, so FOMC was 'dead' on 123 trade days (2023-11-02..2024-04-30) and its _active flags read 1
fix: 2023-12-13, 2024-01-31, 2024-03-20 14:30 added in code; 2024-05-01 14:30 is the next event of the last rows' fomc_until_inv (no dead tail)

title: _active flags from observed prints, at their observed mode on unobserved rows (supersedes the FOMC-only tail fix)
problem: flags were read off the forward-filled column; voldemand's mode-inflated class itself existed only because of the fill (14-16 % zeros among prints, 59-60 % after it)
fix: flag from observed prints; unobserved rows take the flag's modal value over the observed rows before them; with 5c the class is decided causally
counts: v2 16:00 design: voldemand's 24 _active columns gone; StockTwits sentiment / sentcount / attention gain 18 (mode-inflated 2010-07..2016-12 / 2010-07..2013-06 / one week of 2009-07); numobs, FOMC kept

title: Look-ahead: neutral fill
problem: unobserved rows took the FULL-SAMPLE median of the adjusted series
fix: expanding median of observed values strictly before the row; before a series' first print, its first observed value (constant there)
counts: test-window gap to the old fill <= 0.22 IQR (vix3m), mean <= 0.08 IQR

title: Look-ahead: signed s.d. floor
problem: floor = 0.1 x full-sample median per-slot s.d.
fix: 0.1 x expanding median of the (already lagged) per-slot s.d. up to the row
counts: causal floor 8-50 % above the old one; divisor changes on 0-13,047 test-window rows per series (sumret3_ew), 0-479 trade-day 15:30 bars (ofi_ew)

title: Look-ahead: mode-inflation class and mode
problem: decided on the full sample (stocktwits_sentiment would be inflated on data to 2018-06)
fix: expanding over observed prints strictly before the row, >= 250 prints (MODE_MIN_PRINTS); flag 0 where not inflated

title: Look-ahead: guard point-mass test (vvix case)
problem: _build_scale_guards tested the whole design column for a point mass (adj_vvix ladders: inflated in the first window, not over the full sample)
fix: tested at each 480-row grid point on the rows before it (exact running mode, _PastMode)
counts: per-bar: 6 vvix + 1 numobs ladder decisions differ between first window and full sample

title: Look-ahead: asinh routing
problem: routed on the full-sample pinned share (and a late feed's pre-start years counted as pinned); warm-up scale = full-sample median
fix: routed per row on the pinned share since the series' first print, rows before it (>= 250); warm-up scale undefined -> 0
counts: routing unchanged in practice (voldemand routed, every other signed series not)

title: First training window's scaler statistics
problem: rows [0, W) scaled with that window's own median / IQR
fix: none (first-window-frozen: no data after the first forecast; no test row touched)

title: B from regular bars; early-close sessions out of per-bar designs
problem: post-13:00 early-close bars depressed the 16:00 slot's B for 20 sessions (94 of 866 trade days); 22 early-close 16:00 rows (post-close futures bars) were training rows
fix: B over the last 20 REGULAR in-slot bars (rows 13:30-17:00 of the 55 NYSE early-close dates excluded; they take the next regular B); per-bar designs drop those sessions; the pooled panel keeps the rows
src_flags: src/backtest/executor.py:125 B_REGULAR_BARS_ONLY, :129 DROP_EARLY_CLOSE_SESSIONS; calendar src/data/loading.py NYSE_EARLY_CLOSE_DATES
counts: B changes on 180 16:00 test sessions (94 trade days, max 36 %); 28 sessions dropped from the 16:00 design (5 in the scored window)
measured: on top of abcd (trimmed scorer): QLIKE -0.11..-0.26 %, DM -0.56..-1.19 (n.s.); Sharpe mid ridge +0.23, enet +0.20, lasso -0.04, baseline +0.07

title: ref_iqr erosion in bars
problem: the per-bar design eroded the availability mask by w ROWS = w sessions (ma_3125 needed 3,125 consecutive sessions): 46 adj columns stuck at the 1.0 warm-up floor on test rows (e.g. turnover_vw ma_3125: ref 1.0 vs 0.022)
fix: w bars -> ceil(w x rows-a-session / 46) rows for a time-of-day slice; pooled unchanged
counts: ref_iqr changes on test rows for 224 of 282 adj columns; warm-up-floor columns 46 -> 9

title: HAR burn-in in bar space
problem: the 3,125-row burn-in was applied after slicing to one bar a session (3,125 sessions): the 16:00 design started 2010-07-12
fix: burn-in on the full bar grid before the slice (run_executor passes burn_in=0 to _backtest_and_save)
counts: 16:00 design 3,469 -> 6,490 sessions (6,462 after item 6), from 1998-06-04; first forecast 2006-06-14 instead of 2018-06-25
